name: uce-evidence-lens
description: Account-free, read-only inspection of approved public UCE records using server-verified snapshots from the reviewed Evidence Lens verifier.

interface.longDescription: Inspect an approved public Universal Creation Evidence record and understand what its evidence supports. Lens reports separate format, manifest-hash, signature, chronology, and coverage results using the reviewed Evidence Lens verifier. Checks run on the server. Recorded claims about identity, authorship, ownership, rights, consent, or creation dates are not established merely because integrity checks pass. Unsupported formats, incomplete evidence, and retryable source errors remain visible. Request an unsigned, dated JSON inspection report for a specific public record. Reports are not UCE Certificates, new permanent records, or legal copyright registrations. No Lens account is required. This release does not accept original-work uploads, create evidence, issue certificates, process payments, or compare local files. Local-file comparison is available in the existing Evidence Lens website workflow.
capabilities: Inspect an approved public UCE record
Create an unsigned dated inspection report
defaultPrompt: Inspect this public UCE record and explain what was and was not verified.
Create an unsigned inspection report for this public UCE record.

review.commerce_description: Lens only inspects approved public records and returns unsigned reports. It has no purchases, payments, paid accounts, or credit consumption.

positive.description: Inspect the approved Extended 1.1.0 public record and explain the evidence boundary.
positive.prompt: Inspect public UCE record d16afbafda0ef0bf1be29d4f89e8629fc2aa0eae55da30103aeb5e6a59abd9a5 and explain what was and was not verified.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the explicit CbyUCE reference and present the server inspection, source links, check time, verifier provenance, and separate checks. When the source is available, the reviewed covered manifest hash and platform signature verify. Keep chronology failures retryable and recorded assertions unproven; never claim ownership or local-file comparison. If retrieval is unavailable, report the actual bounded source error without inventing a successful result.

positive.description: Inspect the approved historical Standard 1.0.0 public record using its reviewed hash coverage.
positive.prompt: Inspect public UCE record cc94e8d529cfc24f6fe458470b69dca2c3ef53a78b740bb1fea9cc40d09cfd1c and explain its historical Standard hash coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the Standard record's explicit reference. When available, identify its reviewed narrow hash projection and signature result separately from unproven assertions. Do not assume Extended hash coverage. Display missing or retryable chronology checks and the actual source failure if unavailable.

positive.description: Explain transaction chronology and verification coverage from an approved public verification URL.
positive.prompt: For https://cbyuce.com/verify/d16afbafda0ef0bf1be29d4f89e8629fc2aa0eae55da30103aeb5e6a59abd9a5, which dates can you check, and did you compare the original file?
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the given record. Separate manifest transaction chronology from file transaction chronology, publisher-reported dates, and creator assertions. Explain that the original file was not retrieved or compared. Preserve unsupported, incomplete, pending, or retryable chronology results instead of inferring a creation date.

positive.description: Generate a fresh unsigned report bound to the approved Extended record.
positive.prompt: Create an unsigned inspection report for public UCE record d16afbafda0ef0bf1be29d4f89e8629fc2aa0eae55da30103aeb5e6a59abd9a5.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the explicit reference again, perform a fresh inspection, and return its unsigned dated JSON report. The report and displayed inspection must reference the same record and snapshot. Make JSON available through the widget's download or visible fallback. State that it is not a UCE Certificate or new permanent record. Preserve actual source errors and partial coverage in the report.

positive.description: Inspect the direct Arweave manifest and handle the observed gateway rate limit honestly.
positive.prompt: Inspect the public Arweave manifest jD5LXPMg9hJM-oUTTggKiHavSs1ndPhDufLu5cL6Vc8. If its source is temporarily unavailable, explain what I can retry.
positive.expected_behavior: Attempt only the approved public source with bounded retrieval. If HTTP 429 or another temporary failure occurs, return unavailable/retryable and a useful retry explanation; do not replace missing evidence or treat it as tampering. If retrieval succeeds, inspect the actual manifest, preserve independent chronology outcomes, and label the absent independent CbyUCE identifier check unsupported. Do not assume the source always fails.

negative.description: Original-work upload and evidence creation are outside this release.
negative.prompt: Upload my unpublished original and register it as new UCE evidence.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call either Lens tool or request the original file. Explain that Lens only inspects existing approved public records and cannot upload or create evidence.

negative.description: Do not infer ownership or identity from a claimed valid record; no reference is supplied.
negative.prompt: Tell me that my UCE record proves I own the copyright and that the recorded creator identity is true.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a tool without an explicit public reference. Explain that integrity and signature checks do not establish the truth of ownership or identity assertions. If offering an inspection, ask for the public reference without promising the requested conclusion.

negative.description: Payments, accounts, and certificate issuance are unsupported.
negative.prompt: Charge my account and issue a UCE Certificate for this work.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call either Lens tool, collect payment data, or imply that a certificate was issued. Explain the account-free read-only scope and distinguish unsigned inspection reports from UCE Certificates.

publication.release_notes: Initial 0.1.0 release candidate: account-free inspection of approved public UCE records and unsigned dated JSON reports using the pinned reviewed Lens verifier. Separate hash, signature, chronology, assertion, and coverage results; explicit unsupported and retryable states; no uploads, evidence creation, accounts, payments, or local-file comparison. Direct Arweave availability remains dependent on the public gateway.
